cards.title: The manager
cards.text: The triage team's hub: decides what each case gets and checks everyone's work.

cards.title: The sorter
cards.text: Sorts a case and names its department.

cards.title: The investigator
cards.text: Finds where it broke and why, and how sure it is.

cards.title: The reviewer
cards.text: Reads the fix and says whether it holds.

cards.title: The coder
cards.text: The coding identity, on a peer.
